AGRICULTURE — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Structures in Animal production? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Structures in Animal production.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Structures in Animal production.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Structures in Animal production.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Structures in Animal production.

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

7. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

8. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Aquaculture.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Aquaculture.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Aquaculture.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Aquaculture.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Health: Parasite control? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Health: Parasite control.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Health: Parasite control.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Health: Parasite control.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Health: Parasite control.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Production Structures? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Production Structures.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Production Structures.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Production Structures.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Production Structures.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Selected Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Selected Animals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Selected Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Selected Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Selected Animals.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agroforestry? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agroforestry.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agroforestry.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Agroforestry.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agroforestry.

14. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Vegetative propagation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Vegetative propagation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Vegetative propagation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Vegetative propagation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Vegetative propagation.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Livestock Products? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Products.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Livestock Products.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Livestock Products.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Livestock Products.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water conservation.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water conservation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water conservation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water conservation.

18. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

19. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Inorganic fertilisers? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Inorganic fertilisers.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Inorganic fertilisers.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Inorganic fertilisers.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Inorganic fertilisers.

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Digestive systems of animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Digestive systems of animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Digestive systems of animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Digestive systems of animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Digestive systems of animals.

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Pest control? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Pest control.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Pest control.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Pest control.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Pest control.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Structures in Animal production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Aquaculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Rearing Selected Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Livestock Products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Powered Tools and Equipment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Management of Agro- byproducts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Agri- business Accounts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Inorganic fertilisers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
